Enrichment moves 2026-10-06 (zcode:enrich-mytheme-l3), per scene:
#0 poems — the replay authored as motion: attract pointer at 0.4 (the invitation that draws the other back), auto-play, a sine LFO on circulation — the game's coming and going; the pawn's sequence resets it ♟ → inverted → ♟ (the board set up again); FT-P04's one breath walks 0·1 → All→none → 0·1 (the Two Ones, then the release of the All's finality). Duration 12.
#1 roads — THE 3D SCENE. z is the fork's divergence: the cancellation road receding (2→0 at z −0.4), the generation road near (4+2 at z +0.35), the P3 ring at middle depth playing itself apart through its rotation-and-shrink sequence — ring around the Rosie, falling down through the loop. Each road walks its own printed row; vortex + shove pointer (the fork refuses one road); depth perspective + occlusion. Duration 13.
#2 prose — grid layout: six images in cells that hold their seams (adjacency without identity — the record's own caution against turning emblem, operator and diagnosis into one evidence); repel + pulse pointer (each image keeps its own conditions); the cage/window sequence ▣ → ☐ → ▣☐ (enclose, admit, both need the frame); the broken token drifts together and brightens (recognition through fit); the taijitu walks ∵∴ → ∴ → unmarked (two dots, one dot, the erasure). Duration 12.
#3 black sun — attract + implode pointer at 0.6 (capture's intake); circulation −0.35 with auto-capture, a slow sine LFO — attention's drift toward a centre that does not answer; the four rings step inward Neptune → Jupiter → Mercury → corona (deepening red, shrinking); the radiating star's sequence ✷ dim → bright and larger (the alternative destination: outward as generative power). Duration 14 — the longest middle beat, capture takes time.
#4 return — ring layout: the return held in the round; attract pointer at 0.3 (the way back stays open); the shoe's ring returns smaller and paled (fit, then returned); Bimba's sequence C38 → pratibimba → C38 (the office occupied, the wider relation kept). Duration 15, the longest beat — the return takes its time.
ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: #0's checkmate that asks to be played again returns at #4 as the exact office of return — play beginning again, the six routes falling through their loop, the shoe fitting and being returned: each ending qualifying its work. The fork's two operations (#1: cancellation vs the 4+2 generation) return as the black sun's intake against the star's radiating circulation (#3): the same two fates of relation, first as arithmetic, then as social power; the pointer arcs from the player's invitation (0.4 attract) through the fork's shove and capture's implode to the return's gentle 0.3 — the way back to the particular words stays open.
Human-amplified staging: the kickers carry the flags exactly (#1's complementary lean, #3's adopted operations); the scene bodies state whose account where the record flags it. Mythemic verbs only: the poems and images demonstrate and perform their operations; no formal entailment, no independent arithmetic, history or calculus identity claimed.

glyph_rationales.♟: checkmate — the game's apparent end that asks to be played again; the reset pawn is the replayed opening (FT-P01).
glyph_rationales.0·1: FT-P04's one breath — the 0 is the One, the 1 is the All; the Two Ones held in different offices.
glyph_rationales.All→none: FT-P04's own turn — 'the All is none, once and for all'; the All's claim to finality released.
glyph_rationales.2→0: P0's first road — the poles resolved as opposed signed ones and cancelled (FT-P11).
glyph_rationales.2→(−1)+1=0: P0's first printed row — the opposed signed ones summed to zero; the fate of relation under addition.
glyph_rationales.4+2: P0's second road — the four ordered pairings with the generating two retained (FT-P11).
glyph_rationales.00 01 10 11: the four ordered pairings generated from 0 and 1 before their retention as 4+2 (FT-P11's printed row).
glyph_rationales.2: FT-P15's first sign — 'we forgot that one really is two'; humility as the prerequisite of precision.
glyph_rationales.…: FT-P16's three pauses — 'so, to speak'; finding the limit made an act of language.
glyph_rationales.▣: the cage — the frame that encloses what it claims to show, its bounds made the creature's world.
glyph_rationales.☐: the window — the frame that keeps a definite edge while admitting light and air from beyond it (C21).
glyph_rationales.▣☐: cage and window together — the difference requires the frame in both cases.
glyph_rationales.⧒⧓: the broken token's halves — each referring past itself to the absent other; recognition through their fit (A23).
glyph_rationales.∵∴: the two dots retained — each field of the taijitu keeping the other within it; the living whole (A13).
glyph_rationales.∴: the one-dot orientation — a reading within the relation before the erasure that keeps form and loses reciprocity.
glyph_rationales.✷: the radiating star — what reaches the centre becoming available outward as generative power.
glyph_rationales.→→: the attention sequence — cynicism, exhaustion, blankness; the field readied for re-inscription.
glyph_rationales.G?: God as Other — source, law or archetypal totality addressed as exceeding a finite mind's possession.
glyph_rationales.4: the four operators of one alterity encounter — God, shadow, friend, alien/enemy; distinct offices, not character classes.
glyph_rationales.C38: the recursive Bimba — a reference genuinely occupying a relative original's office within a wider relation.
glyph_rationales.pratibimba: the reflected office — the reference remaining image inside the wider relation that holds it.
